avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Click the avatar to upload a photo from your device.
avatar.hint: Optional, but it helps people recognize you.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Your full name or a name you are comfortable with. Members of your organizations see it.
name.label: Display name

email.title: Email
email.description: The address you sign in with and where account mail goes.
email.label: Email
email.hint: We email your current address to confirm a change first.
email.saveFailed: Could not start the email change.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and everything tied to it: your profile, sessions and organization memberships.
delete.hint: We email you a link to confirm. This cannot be undone.
delete.blocked: You are the only owner of {organizations}. Make someone else an owner, or delete them, before you delete your account.
delete.dialogDescription: We will send a confirmation link to {email}. Your account is deleted only after you open it and confirm.
delete.sendFailed: Could not send the confirmation link.
delete.confirmDescription: This deletes the account for {email} right away. It cannot be undone.
delete.consequenceProfile: Your profile and photo are removed.
delete.consequenceMemberships: You leave every organization you belong to.
delete.failed: Could not delete your account. The link may have expired; request a new one from your profile.
delete.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one from your profile.

password.title: Password
password.description: Sign in with your email address and a password.
password.changeHint: Changing it signs out your other devices.
password.setHint: You sign in with Google now. A password adds a second way in.
password.changeDescription: Enter your current password, then the new one. Other devices will be signed out.
password.setDescription: Add a password so you can also sign in with {email}.
password.saved: Your password was updated. Other devices were signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: After your password, ask for a code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.offHint: Works with any authenticator app, such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy.
twoFactor.onHint: Keep your backup codes somewhere safe in case you lose your phone.
twoFactor.needsPassword: Set a password first. Two-factor protects password sign-in; Google sign-in is protected by your Google account.
twoFactor.backupCodesDescription: One-time codes for when your app is out of reach

setup.title: Set up two-factor authentication
setup.scanStep: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.manualKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key instead:
setup.codesStep: Two-factor authentication is on. Save these backup codes: each one signs you in once if you lose your phone.
setup.invalidCode: That code did not work. Enter the newest one from your app.

codes.title: Backup codes
codes.description: Generating new codes stops the old ones from working. Confirm your password to continue.
codes.generated: Save these codes. Each one works once.

disableDialog.title: Turn off two-factor authentication?
disableDialog.description: Signing in will ask for your password only. Confirm your password to continue.
disableDialog.failed: Could not turn off two-factor authentication.

connections.title: Connected accounts
connections.description: Sign in with an account you already have.
connections.hint: The connected account must use the same email as this one.
connections.onlyMethod: Set a password before you disconnect your only way to sign in.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices signed in to your account. Sign out any you do not recognize.
sessions.hint: Signing out a device ends its session at once.
sessions.onlyThisDevice: You are only signed in on this device.
sessions.revokeFailed: Could not sign out the device.
sessions.signOutOthersFailed: Could not sign out the other devices.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose how the app looks in this browser.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language of the app in this browser.
